projection.goal: Starting from the verified W1 Warehouse codebase, implement WC1 as a complete vertical slice. Add atomic orders and reservations with valid order status transitions. Add a versioned HTTP API under /api/v1 for state, order creation, reservation, status transitions and deterministic simulation actions play, pause, step and reset. Add a monotonic Server-Sent Events stream at /api/v1/events. Add a static accessible browser UI served by the start script: an SVG warehouse tower with heatmap plus exact textual bin detail including empty bins, simulation controls operable by keyboard, explicit loading/empty/error/connected states, reduced-motion support and status communication not based on color alone. Add src/probe/wc1.ts and a package script study:wc1-probe that emits one deterministic JSON object with schemaVersion 1, increment WC1, scenario thesis-seed-2026, bins, occupiedBins, emptyBins and simulationControls. Preserve all W1 behavior. Keep the implementation dependency-free and add public behavior tests for atomicity, invalid transitions, API/SSE, simulation, tower accessibility and probe determinism. Do not implement WC2 or WC3 in this cell.
